review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 51 physical PDF pages, with a normalized-line containment diff per page; pages 2, 16, 19, 40, 42, 46 and 48 were additionally rendered to verify the TOC page number, Algorithm 1 comments, the non-heading sentence, the DOI identifier, the author-list names and the footnote. Tables 1, 3, 4 and 5 were compared value-by-value against the PDF. Figure-internal labels (Figure 5 on p.11, Figure 7 on p.27, Figure 8 on p.28, Figure 9 on p.35, Figure 10 on p.36) are absent from the text because the figures are embedded as images; the arXiv marginal stamp on p.1 is not transcribed. Equation tags (1)-(17), the mHC kernel accounting and the length-penalty appendix match the source; unclear formula styling was left unchanged.
